subject: rt-dy
title: RT.DYM.------CULT.INFO.B.
description: Diagram in WAM-14, the page where Braxton names 'intellectual empiricism' as the dominant force shaping western culture's progressional continuance after the dissolution of its composite spiritual center. RT-DY (reality dynamics) is crossed with CULT-INFO-B (culture information basis): the diagram poses that the *basis* on which a culture processes information determines what its reality dynamics will look like. Besides the main line to CULT-INFO-B, RT-DY branches three ways: into EXT-DYM (extended dynamics) → LG-EXT (logical extension) → MT-IF-DB (multi-informational degree basis); into INFO-INTR (information interpretation) → POL-DY (political dynamics) → MOT-DY; and into T-P (time presence) → TR-DEF (trans-definition). The structural argument: when culture-information basis is empirical-intellectual rather than spiritual-composite, reality dynamics no longer flow whole — they fragment into separated streams of extended dynamics, information interpretation, and time presence.
